temperature_c.source: DEMO ONLY - placeholder for tests and simulator

soil_moisture_percent.source: DEMO ONLY - placeholder for tests and simulator

temperature_c.source: min: night 15-17 C, Univ. of Arizona CEAC Greenhouse Crop Production ch.3. max (cooling trigger): Harel et al. 2014, Agronomy 4:167-177, cooling started above 30 C and stopped at 28 C. Cross-check: WSU Extension TB103E cooling threshold 85-90 F
temperature_c.note: Instant air temperature trigger. The 24h mean should stay at or below 25-26 C (see mean_daily_c). Fan has no hysteresis yet.

mean_daily_c.source: Harel et al. 2014, Agronomy 4:167-177 (25-26 C mean daily is the upper limit for fruit set and yield)
mean_daily_c.note: Needs a 24h average. Not used by the controller yet.

humidity_percent.source: Univ. of Arizona CEAC Greenhouse Crop Production ch.3
humidity_percent.note: Harel et al. 2014: daytime RH 50-70% best for pollination, 90% raises pollen heat sensitivity. Not used by the controller yet.

soil_moisture_percent.note: Depends on sensor calibration (Ashraf et al. 2026). Nelson 7e ch.8 uses substrate tension 20-30 kPa, not percent.

co2_ppm.source: Nelson, Greenhouse Operation and Management 7e, ch.10

temperature_c.source: min: Gruda et al., Cucumber (GAP for greenhouse vegetable production, SEE countries), fruits shorter below 18 C. max: Purdue Extension ID-521-W, day 77-84 F. Cross-check: Oregon State Extension; Amin et al. 2024 BMC Plant Biology 24:903 (25/18 C normal growth, 9/5 C severe damage)
temperature_c.note: One band covering day and night.

humidity_percent.source: max: Amin et al. 2024 BMC Plant Biology 24:903 (95% RH reduced growth and chlorophyll vs 80%); NMSU Circular 556 (above 90% encourages disease in greenhouse vegetables)
humidity_percent.note: Upper limit only. No cucumber-specific lower limit found. Not used by the controller yet.

co2_ppm.source: Nelson, Greenhouse Operation and Management 7e, ch.10

temperature_c.source: min: tuber formation 15-18 C, Mohamed et al. 2010, J. Biol. Chem. Environ. Sci. 5(3):769-785 (Egypt). max: early growth 20-25 C (same paper); shoot growth maximum at 25 C, Tibbitts, Cao and Wheeler, NASA CR-177646 (1994)
temperature_c.note: Cool-season crop. Tuber development optimum about 16-20 C (NASA CR-177646). Hard to hold in a hot greenhouse without cooling.

humidity_percent.note: No numeric range found. Late blight spreads under sustained high humidity, haze and cloud (Shovon et al., GAUIC 2025 poster).
